how: Each row Google Maps flagged on 2026-11-24 was looked at again: the row's own tip for a season it already names, a fresh Maps search on the address (and the local name) to see whether Maps landed on this very place, then one web search or the place's own site. A winter or between-seasons closure is a season (noted in the tip where missing); a closure with no reopening date or a rebuild of more than about six months is a removal; a museum that moved within its town keeps its row with the new address.

rows.name: Dachstein Giant Ice Cave
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open 1 May–1 November 2026"; Maps "Temporarily closed" is the winter closure.

rows.name: Hellbrunn Palace and Trick Fountains
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open daily 28 March – 1 November 2026"; Maps shows the winter closure.

rows.name: Salzburg Open-Air Museum
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open daily ... from spring to autumn; Advent weekends from 28 November".

rows.name: Leopoldskron Outdoor Pool
rows.evidence: Maps: "Freibad Leopoldskron · Public swimming pool · Temporarily closed" (outdoor pool, off season). Salzburg24/MeinBezirk: the Lepi opened 8 May 2026 and stayed open daily until 20 September 2026. Season added to tip.

rows.name: Leos Rumpelkiste
rows.evidence: Re-run of Maps on "Rumpelkiste, Blumauergasse 1a, Wien" lands on this very place: "Rumpelkiste · Indoor playground · Temporarily closed", no hours. An indoor playground has no season; its site (rumpelkiste.wien) was last modified 2025-02-21 and names no reopening; web search found no news of a reopening date. Reopening unknown -> removed (Vienna keeps 28 sights, 16 indoor).

rows.name: Stanserhorn CabriO
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Season from 11 April 2026"; the cable car runs summer only.

rows.name: Musegg Wall
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open 1 April–1 November ...; closed in winter".

rows.name: BLS winter boat on Lake Thun
rows.evidence: Maps landed on the BLS ship station office in Thun (a tour-operator listing); the tip already says one winter boat runs daily on Lake Thun.

rows.name: Brienz Rothorn Railway
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Seasonal: 6 June–25 October 2026 to the summit".

rows.name: Spiez Castle
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Museum and café open 1 May to 31 October".

rows.name: Oberhofen Castle
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Season May to October".

rows.name: Allmendhubel
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "The funicular is closed 19 October to 11 December 2026".

rows.name: Reichenbach Falls
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "The funicular runs May to October only"; the falls themselves are a natural site.

rows.name: Swiss Vapeur Parc
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "A seasonal park ... check the 2027 dates".

rows.name: Geneva Adventure Park (Evaux)
rows.evidence: Maps: "Geneva Adventure Park · Parc Aventure Genève · Temporarily closed" (off season). loisirs.ch: "De mars à novembre"; geneve.com lists it closed on Mondays. Season added to tip.

rows.name: Sunnegga and Wolli's Adventure Park at Leisee
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "The play areas are for the snow-free season".

rows.name: Snowli Kids Village ski school
rows.evidence: Maps landed on another place: "Snow Kids Village Schönried" (Saanen), not Zermatt; the row is a winter activity and its tip says so.

rows.name: Seebad Utoquai
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Season 2026 ran 11 April–25 October; check the 2027 dates".

rows.name: Waldhochseilgarten Jungfernheide
rows.evidence: Maps: "Waldhochseilgarten Jungfernheide · High ropes course · Temporarily closed" (winter break). The park's own site gives its opening hours "validFrom 2026-03-07". Season added to tip.

rows.name: Kinderbad at Monbijoux Park
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Pool season is May to August".

rows.name: Cologne City Museum
rows.evidence: Address updated. Maps marks the old Zeughaus address "Permanently closed"; a Maps search for "Kölnisches Stadtmuseum, Minoritenstraße 11, Köln" lands on "Kölnisches Stadtmuseum · Museum · Minoritenstraße 13, 50667 Köln · Closed · Opens 10 AM". Cologne Tourism: after water damage the museum moved from the Zeughaus (1958–2017) to its interim home in the former Franz Sauer fashion house, Minoritenstraße 13. Same museum, same town: area, what and q updated, row kept.

rows.name: Energieberg Georgswerder
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "The season ends on 31 October each year".

rows.name: Märchenparadies Königstuhl
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Season 2026 about 14 March–11 November".

rows.name: Munich Christkindlmarkt at Marienplatz
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open 20 Nov–24 Dec 2026"; Maps' place page still shows the between-markets status.

rows.name: Marienbrücke and Pöllat Gorge
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "the gorge and bridge are closed in winter, usually about November to March".

rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Seasonal: reopened 15 March 2026 ... may be closed in winter".

rows.name: Mont Blanc Museum
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "closed 2 November to 15 December 2026".

rows.name: Lake Annecy Ecomuseum
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Opening is seasonal ... check winter hours".

rows.name: Parc de Merlet
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "2026 season May to September".

rows.name: Le Semnoz
rows.evidence: Maps: "Station du Semnoz · Ski resort · Temporarily closed" (between seasons). Skiinfo and the town of Annecy: the 2026–27 ski season is planned 18 December 2026 to 28 March 2027; Alti-mag lists summer activities. Season added to tip.

rows.name: Acro’Aventures Talloires
rows.evidence: Maps: "ACRO' AVENTURES TALLOIRES · High ropes course · Temporarily closed". The operator's Talloires page lists a "Fermeture annuelle" and says only its Reignier park "reste ouvert toute l'année". Season added to tip.

rows.name: Écomusée de la Baie du Mont-Saint-Michel
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "outside holidays hours are short, so check"; a small seasonal museum in winter.

rows.name: Parc Spirou Provence
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "The 2026 season ran to 11 November, so check the 2027 opening dates".

rows.name: Montagne des Singes
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "2026 season ended 11 November, usually reopens in March".

rows.name: Volerie des Aigles
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "2026 season ended 11 November, reopens in spring".

rows.name: Colmar little train
rows.evidence: Maps: "PETIT TRAIN TOURISTIQUE de COLMAR (VERT) · Temporarily closed" (off season). Tourisme Colmar: the little train runs daily April to October (2025 run 5 April–19 October). Season added to tip.

rows.name: Base Nautique Colmar-Houssen
rows.evidence: Maps: "Base Nautique Colmar Houssen · Swimming lake · Temporarily closed" (off season). Local agenda (jds.fr): the 2026 summer season ran 20 May–27 September. Season added to tip.

rows.name: Alsatian Museum
rows.evidence: Maps re-run: "Alsatian Museum · Musée alsacien · Temporarily closed". Strasbourg museums: closed for major works since 7 July 2025 (roof and the permanent route); the March 2025 press release planned a reopening at the end of the first half of 2027, the city's hours page now says "Fermé - Travaux" until 1 June 2028. Long rebuild -> removed (Strasbourg keeps 24 sights).

rows.name: France Miniature
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open 4 April to 1 November 2026 ...; closed in winter".

rows.name: Ceramics Museum, Villa Guariglia
rows.evidence: Maps re-run on "Museo della Ceramica Villa Guariglia Vietri" lists "Museo della Ceramica di Villa Guariglia" as "Temporarily closed". A museum with no season; no page found with a reopening date (listings are undated or from 2023). Reopening unknown -> removed (Amalfi keeps 25 sights). Unsure: the closure's cause is not known.

rows.name: Alpe di Siusi cable car
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Summer season 22 May–2 Nov 2026, winter from 5 Dec 2026 ...; the lift is closed in between".

rows.name: Messner Mountain Museum Firmian
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Open mid-March to early November ...; closed for the winter now".

rows.name: Messner Mountain Museum Corones
rows.evidence: the row's tip already names the season: "Winter season 28 Nov 2026–11 Apr 2027".

rows.name: Tuffalm
rows.evidence: Maps: "Tuffalm · Malga Tuff · Temporarily closed" (a mountain hut). Südtirolerland: open in summer and until early January, closed in winter (January to mid-April); Seiser Alm gives other winter dates. Season added to tip (dates noted as differing).

rows.name: Prösels Castle
rows.evidence: Maps: "Castel Prösels · Castle · Temporarily closed". The castle's own page: guided tours "Every day, except Saturday 01.05. - 31.10.", plus some winter tours. Season added to tip.

rows.name: Merano 2000
rows.evidence: Maps: "Talstation Seilbahn Meran 2000 · Mountain cable car · Temporarily closed". Meran 2000's own site: "Il comprensorio é chiuso. NEW OPENING DATE: 04.12.2026". Season added to tip.

rows.name: Cavallino Matto
rows.evidence: Maps: "CavallinoMatto · Theme park · Temporarily closed" (winter). A seasonal park: spring to autumn; a 2026 guide gives the opening day as 4 April; the park's site (modified 19 Nov 2026) announces its 2026 new ride. The old tip "Open every day" was wrong in winter; season added to tip.

rows.name: San Silvestro mining park
rows.evidence: Maps: "Parco Archeominerario di San Silvestro · Park · Temporarily closed". The Ministry of Culture listing says to check the park's site for days and hours; the Val di Cornia parks' 2026 flyers cover the summer season. Seasonal note added to tip.

rows.name: Bagni Misteriosi
rows.evidence: Maps: "Bagni Misteriosi · Outdoor swimming pool · Temporarily closed". Mentelocale/Milanofree: the pool opened for summer on 1 June 2026. Season added to tip.

rows.name: Museum of Illusions
rows.evidence: Maps re-run lands on this very place: "Museo delle Illusioni Roma · Museum · Via Merulana, 17 · Temporarily closed", no hours. The museum's site still lists Rome but says online ticket sales are "temporarily unavailable"; no page gives a reopening date. Reopening unknown -> removed (Rome keeps 33 sights). Unsure: the site still invites visitors to buy at the ticket office.

rows.name: Ursino Castle and Civic Museum, Catania
rows.evidence: Maps re-run: "Ursino Castle · Castello Ursino · Temporarily closed". La Sicilia (May 2026) and others: closed since 7 February 2025 for a restoration of about 4 million euros, the Civic Museum's rooms being rebuilt, reopening expected in 2027. Long rebuild -> removed (Sicily keeps 25 sights).
